children: Elmet Group announced a suite of strategic agreements, led by an Investment Agreement with the Department of War for up to $450 million in preferred equity and warrants to expand U.S. tungsten capacity. The company also issued 10-year Penny and Strike Price Warrants, executed Registration and Investor Rights Agreements with governance and allocation rights, and adopted a Restricted Entity Compliance Plan. Separately, Elmet signed a binding letter with Blue Moon Metals and EQ Resources to form a JV to restart the Springer APT plant in Nevada and agreed an exclusive offtake with the Defense Logistics Agency featuring a $150 million minimum and up to $1.85 billion in additional purchases. Collectively, these actions fund growth, secure feedstock and demand, and strengthen supply chain resilience.
Agreement 1: Elmet Group Secures Up to $450 Million DoW Investment via Preferred Stock and Warrants
: Equity investment agreement for Class A Preferred Stock and warrants
: Up to 10 years (warrants); staged tranche windows
: Fund U.S. tungsten capacity expansion and supply chain resilience
Agreement 2: Elmet Group Issues 10-Year Penny Warrant to DoW for 5.68 Million Shares
: Provide upside participation aligned with investment
Agreement 3: Elmet Group Grants DoW 10-Year Strike Price Warrant for 1.89 Million Shares at $15.92
: Strike Price Warrant for common stock
: Align long-term incentives and comply with Nasdaq pricing
Agreement 4: Elmet Group and DoW Sign Registration Rights to Enable Warrant Share Resale
: Registration Rights Agreement for resale of warrant shares
Agreement 5: Elmet Group and DoW Enter Investor Rights Pact With Board Seat and Preemptive Rights
: Investor Rights Agreement with governance, preemptive and allocation rights
: Align governance and secure strategic product access
Agreement 6: Elmet Group Adopts Restricted Entity Rights Plan to Comply With DoW Agreement
: Restricted Entity Compliance Plan (shareholder rights plan)
: Prevent restricted entities from significant ownership
Agreement 7: Elmet Group, Blue Moon and EQ Outline JV to Restart Nevada APT Plant
: Binding letter for JV, equity investment and prepayment facility
: Restart domestic APT production and secure concentrate supply
Agreement 8: Elmet Group Wins DLA Exclusive Offtake: $150 Million Minimum, Up to $2 Billion
: Exclusive government offtake for tungsten materials
: Secure multi-year government demand for tungsten products

title: Elmet Group Secures $450 Million DoW Investment, JV to Restart Nevada APT Plant, DLA Offtake
